lines.text: I now want every man who is determined to stay here and die with me to come across this line.
lines.gloss: told later: Louis Rose’s story as W. P. Zuber printed it (1873, reprinted later); historians doubt it
lines.name: Travis

lines.text: Gregorio, the soldiers have jumped the wall. The fight’s begun.
lines.gloss: told later: remembered by her son Enrique, about eight that night, in 1902 (he put it at two in the morning)
lines.name: Ana Esparza

lines.text: Come on boys, the Mexicans are upon us, and we’ll give them Hell.
lines.gloss: Joe’s account, as W. F. Gray wrote it down on March 20, 1836

lines.text: It was a miracle, but none of us children were touched.
